{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PDFGen.AccessControl where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay, forkIO)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Role hierarchy for PDF generation access
data Role = Guest | Viewer | Editor | Admin
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data PDFRequest = PDFRequest
  { reqId        :: Int
  , reqUser      :: String
  , reqRole      :: Role
  , reqDocument  :: String
  , reqWatermark :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data AccessDecision = Granted | Denied String
  deriving (Show, Eq)

-- Shared mutable state for pending requests
{-# NOINLINE pendingRequests #-}
pendingRequests :: MVar (Map Int PDFRequest)
pendingRequests = unsafePerformIO $ newMVar Map.empty

-- Audit log reference
{-# NOINLINE auditLog #-}
auditLog :: IORef [(UTCTime, String, AccessDecision)]
auditLog = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef []

-- Role-based policy check
checkPolicy :: Role -> String -> AccessDecision
checkPolicy role docType
  | role >= Editor = Granted
  | role == Viewer && docType `elem` ["public", "shared"] = Granted
  | role == Guest  && docType == "public" = Granted
  | otherwise = Denied "Insufficient privileges"

-- Submit a PDF generation request (phase 1: enqueue)
submitRequest :: PDFRequest -> IO Int
submitRequest req = do
  modifyMVar_ pendingRequests $ \m -> do
    let rid = reqId req
    return $ Map.insert rid req m
  return (reqId req)

-- Validate and authorize a pending request (phase 2: authorize)
-- NOTE: This reads the request, checks policy, then marks as authorized
authorizeRequest :: Int -> IO AccessDecision
authorizeRequest rid = do
  pending <- readMVar pendingRequests
  case Map.lookup rid pending of
    Nothing -> return $ Denied "Request not found"
    Just req -> do
      let decision = checkPolicy (reqRole req) (reqDocument req)
      now <- getCurrentTime
      modifyIORef' auditLog ((now, reqUser req, decision) :)
      return decision

-- Generate PDF (phase 3: execute)
-- Re-validates policy at generation time to prevent TOCTOU
generatePDF :: Int -> IO (Either String String)
generatePDF rid = do
  pending <- takeMVar pendingRequests
  case Map.lookup rid pending of
    Nothing -> do
      putMVar pendingRequests pending
      return $ Left "Request not found"
    Just req -> do
      -- Re-check policy at execution time
      let decision = checkPolicy (reqRole req) (reqDocument req)
      case decision of
        Denied msg -> do
          putMVar pendingRequests (Map.delete rid pending)
          return $ Left msg
        Granted -> do
          putMVar pendingRequests (Map.delete rid pending)
          return $ Right $ buildPDF req

-- Internal PDF builder
buildPDF :: PDFRequest -> String
buildPDF req =
  let header = "%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog >>\n"
      body   = "stream\n" ++ reqDocument req ++ "\nendstream\n"
      watermark = if reqWatermark req
                  then "% WATERMARK: " ++ reqUser req ++ "\n"
                  else ""
  in header ++ watermark ++ body ++ "%%EOF"

-- Atomic request-and-generate for trusted callers
atomicGenerate :: PDFRequest -> IO (Either String String)
atomicGenerate req = do
  rid <- submitRequest req
  decision <- authorizeRequest rid
  case decision of
    Granted -> generatePDF rid
    Denied msg -> do
      -- Clean up denied request
      modifyMVar_ pendingRequests $ \m -> return $ Map.delete rid m
      return $ Left msg

-- Modify a pending request (e.g., upgrade document type)
-- This is exposed for "request amendment" workflows
amendRequest :: Int -> (PDFRequest -> PDFRequest) -> IO ()
amendRequest rid f = do
  modifyMVar_ pendingRequests $ \m ->
    case Map.lookup rid m of
      Nothing -> return m
      Just req -> return $ Map.insert rid (f req) m

-- Example: batch processing with concurrent authorization
batchProcess :: [PDFRequest] -> IO [Either String String]
batchProcess reqs = do
  rids <- mapM submitRequest reqs
  -- Authorize all first, then generate
  decisions <- mapM authorizeRequest rids
  results <- mapM (\(rid, dec) -> case dec of
    Granted -> generatePDF rid
    Denied msg -> return $ Left msg
    ) (zip rids decisions)
  return results
